| **Clean removes too many files** | `<Compile Remove="**\*.g.cs" />` catches all `.g.cs` files | Scoped removal to only proto-generated files via `@(ProtoFile->'...')` transform |
| **Missing files on incremental builds** | `<Compile Include>` inside `GenerateProtoCode` doesn't execute when the target is skipped (up-to-date) | Moved to a separate `IncludeGeneratedProtoCode` target with `AfterTargets="GenerateProtoCode"` — this always runs in the chain regardless of incremental skip, and `FileWrites` is now inside the generating target so clean only tracks actually-created files |
